question:
The percentage of students enrolled in different activities in a school which are displayed in the left side pie chart. The total number of students is 5000.

In the right-side pie chart, the total number of girls is 1550 and their percentage breakup enrolled in these activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca408a9722b78818828dbada16bd6e49e67489679f538d9a5f176b9b3181fdf.png] 

The number of girls enrolled in Craft forms what per cent of the total number of students in the school?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of students = 5000

Total number of girls = 1550

Percentage of girls enrolled in Craft = 22%

**Calculations:**

Number of girls enrolled in Craft = 22% of 1550

⇒ Number of girls enrolled in Craft = 0.22 × 1550

⇒ Number of girls enrolled in Craft = 341

Percentage of the total number of students in the school:

⇒ Percentage = (Number of girls enrolled in Craft / Total number of students) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (341 / 5000) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 6.82%

**∴ The number of girls enrolled in Craft forms 6.82% of the total number of students in the school.**
